# Libraries
```{r}
library(geosphere)
```

-################################################################################

# Import data

## Metadata
```{r}
metadata.sp.comm <- readRDS("../rds/metadata.sp.comm.rds")
```

## Spatial distances between plots
```{r}
plots <- read.csv2("../data/sample_plots_coordinates.csv", header = T, sep = ";", dec = ",")
```

## Bray-curtis distance matrix on Methylobacterium species composition
```{r}
species.bray.dist <- readRDS("../rds/genomes.bray.dist.rds")
```

## Bray-curtis distance matrix on Methylobacterium gene composition
```{r}
 <- readRDS("../rds/......rds")
```


-################################################################################

# Rearrange order of samples in 'plots' to match the 'species.bray.dist' order

```{r}
#species.bray.df <- data.frame(as.matrix(species.bray.dist))
rownames(plots) <- plots$sample
plots2 <- plots[match(rownames(metadata.sp.comm), rownames(plots)),]
```

# Create between plots distance matrix

```{r}
dist_plots <- distm(plots2[, c("longitude", "latitude")], fun = distGeo)
dist_plots <- round(dist_plots, 0)
rownames(dist_plots) <- plots2$sample
colnames(dist_plots) <- plots2$sample
```

# Add random distance between samples of same plots (between 2 and 10 meters)

```{r}
set.seed(123456)
# number of plots
n <- nrow(dist_plots)
# create matrix of random distances between 2 and 10
rand_dist <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)
i <- upper.tri(rand_dist) 
rand_dist[i] <- runif(sum(i), min = 2, max = 10)
rand_dist <- rand_dist + t(rand_dist) # copy values to lower triangle
# add the randomly generated distances to between plots distance matrix
dist_plots2 <- dist_plots + rand_dist
isSymmetric(dist_plots2)
all(diag(dist_plots2) == 0)
# round the final plot distance matrix
dist_plots2 <- round(dist_plots2, 0)
```


-################################################################################

# PERMANOVA test on species composition

```{r}
species.plots.perm <- adonis2(species.bray.dist ~ plot, data = metadata.sp.comm)
species.plots.perm
species.plots.disper <- betadisper(species.bray.dist, metadata.sp.comm$plot)
anova(species.plots.disper)
plot(species.plots.disper)
```


# Mantel test on species composition

```{r}
mantel(dist_plots2, species.bray.dist, method = "spearman", permutations = 9999)
```
